title: Blow-up integrals of bounded functions supported in B_R(0) are bounded by M·max(C,0)·Rⁿ under the mass bound
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), let x ∈ ℝ^N, and let C, R, r, M ∈ ℝ with r > 0, R > 0 and μ(B_{rR}(x)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(C·(rR)ⁿ) (open ball). Let h : ℝ^N → ℝ be continuous with |h(z)| ≤ M for every z, and such that h(z) ≠ 0 implies |z| < R. Then y ↦ h(η_{x,r}(y)) is μ-integrable and |(rⁿ)⁻¹ ∫ h(η_{x,r}(y)) dμ(y)| ≤ M · max(C, 0) · Rⁿ, where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) is blowUpMap x r.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (C R r M : ℝ) (h : Rn N → ℝ), 0 < r → 0 < R → μ (Metric.ball x (r * R)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (r * R) ^ n) → Continuous h → (∀ z, |h z| ≤ M) → (∀ z, h z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < R) → Integrable (fun y ↦ h (blowUpMap x r y)) μ ∧ |(r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, h (blowUpMap x r y) ∂μ| ≤ M * max C 0 * R ^ n
